passage:
After a beloved teacher passed away, former students created an online memorial page. People posted photos, stories, and messages from different years.
Some wrote about big lessons. Others remembered small things: the way she wrote comments, the snacks she shared before exams, or the songs she played during cleaning time.
The school also made a physical memory corner in the library.
The online page allowed people far away to join. The library corner gave current students a quiet place to stand.
Together, they showed that memory can live in more than one place. Digital spaces can connect many voices, while physical spaces give grief a room.
